messages:
opsbot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts detected for /v1/generate across us-west-2. 5xx rate up 8x in last 2m, median latency -> 1.8s, p95 -> 7.2s. Suspected queueing/batching saturation.

oncall-jules: acknowledging, I'm live. paging oncall. jumping in - what's the blast radius?

sanjay: seeing large build-up in scheduler batch queues. backlog up ~120k requests. most are short prompt requests but they accumulate and block big sequences. head-of-line observed where old large KV-miss requests are preventing small requests from being batched/served.

marta: logs show repeated "batch_wait_ms exceeded" and gateway upstream 502s. snippet:```
2026-03-15T18:02:02Z srv scheduler: enqueue id=xyz wait_ms=3600
2026-03-15T18:02:03Z runtime: forward timeout to gateway id=xyz 502
2026-03-15T18:02:04Z scheduler: batch forming stalled due to kv_cache_load slow
```

aria: customers: two high-traffic customers reporting increased timeouts, support ticket queue jumping. early estimate: ~3% of hosted traffic affected, some Dedicated pools see secondary impact due to routing fallback.

devon: what immediate mitigations do we want? we can: 1) reduce max_batch_size 2) enable preemptive eviction for low-priority requests 3) route traffic to dedicated fallback nodes 4) increase scheduler workers (if safe).

oncall-jules: do the smallest-disruptive first. reduce batch size and enable eviction. can someone run the change?

marta: I'm applying a soft throttle to batching: setting max_batch_size=16 (was 64) and batch_timeout_ms=80 (was 200). running:```
# update runtime tune knobs
redwoodctl set-config serving.batch.max_size=16 serving.batch.timeout_ms=80 --selector=us-west-2/runtime
```

opsbot: deploybot: config update queued: change id cfg-20260315-001. rolling to us-west-2 runtime group (5 nodes at a time).

sanjay: also enabling preemptive eviction for low-priority queues:```
redwoodctl set-config scheduler.eviction_policy=priority scheduler.eviction_threshold=0.65
```

leo: spinning up 4 extra dedicated fallback workers (dedicated-fallback-2xlarge) and adding route preference to prefer dedicated when latency > 700ms. running: `infra scale pool dedicated-fallback +4 --region us-west-2`

support-bot: note: customer-facing incidents created for cust-A and cust-B, severity P1 pending confirmation. routing support docs link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/runbooks/batching-hol

aria: quick customer impact summary for comms: "We observed elevated 5xx/timeouts impacting a subset of generation requests in us-west-2. Mitigations in progress; limited customer impact to several high-volume integrations. Will follow up with timeline."

oncall-jules: good. anyone seeing immediate improvement?

marta: p95 lat has dropped to 2.1s from 7.2s on the nodes where config rolled. 5xx rate reduced by ~60% in first 2 minutes. backlog still draining though.

sanjay: noticed unusual KV-cache growth tied to one client request pattern (very long unique prefixes, low cache hit). that's causing heavy load on cache loader and stalling batch formation. flagging model-eval team to consider prefix hashing/ttl.

devon: can we temporarily route that client's traffic to non-batched path? we have per-customer routing rules.

marta: yes, adding route override for cust-X to 'no-batching' lane:```
redwoodctl route set --customer=cust-X --route-policy=no-batching --region=us-west-2
```

opsbot: route update applied for cust-X.

leo: support update: cust-A reported 15% error spike during window, cust-B ~8%. both on our P1 watch.

oncall-jules: good progress. next: keep eviction on, let config rollout finish, continue to monitor for ~30m. if we see re-increase, escalate to full scheduler restart.

aria: also opening a follow-up ticket for longer-term: 1) per-customer batching heuristics 2) KV cache eviction tuning and TTL 3) scheduler preemption improvements. assigning to Sanjay + Marta.

marta: note: we had one pod with repeated OOMs while draining big batches; I've cordoned it and will GC logs after. patch queued to reduce batch memory budget.

sanjay: current numbers: backlog down to 28k, 5xx rate down to baseline+10%. gateway timeouts trending down.

devon: routing rules we applied will remain for 1h then auto-evaluate. leaving dedicated-fallback scaled for 30m and then scale down if stable.

oncall-jules: thanks team. I'll stay on watch for the next 45m then hand back to oncall rotation. please post final postmortem note once root cause confirmed.

aria: creating incident ticket #INC-20260315-0819 with timeline + customer impact. adding cust-A/B contacts.

support-bot: update: cust-A and cust-B notified with initial statement.

marta: final check: p95 now 1.1s, backlog <5k. leaving eviction.enabled=true, max_batch_size=16 for now. I'll start a canary to move some nodes back to 32 batch size next hour.

oncall-jules: handoff: I'm clear to leave at 18:51Z, next oncall is @oncall-ryan. please ping if regression.

opsbot: Incident status: mitigation applied, monitoring. Incident channel will auto-close after 2h of stability.

aria: thanks everyone :thumbsup: we captured metrics and actions in the incident ticket. follow-ups assigned.

oncall-jules: ending shift, leaving notes in ticket.
